classification: CPU-only adjudication of source125 native CGLS direction residual/operator replay; zero physical transactions; no nonlinear acceptance or certificate claim.

interpretation.action: Native cached and fresh A*p exports are compared to the exact unsymmetric captured source125 CSR on each exported float32 direction. This checks operator replay, not convergence.
interpretation.best_alpha: Best alpha is the minimum native residual among sampled positive values 1,1/2,...,1/32. The alpha=2 diagnostic point is excluded. This is not an Armijo acceptance and no physical transaction occurred.
interpretation.center: All three center outputs are exact byte matches to source-bound native424 for each direction profile. This binds replay to the same captured linearization center, not to an accepted Newton solve.
limits: All native statuses and material-history checks pass, but these are offline replay diagnostics only.
CGLS truncation does not inherit the original Newton certificate; no direction here was installed as a production correction.
The best sampled alpha is alpha=1 for all five profiles; every smaller tested positive alpha gives a larger native residual.
FP64 CGLS128 predicts a lower linear residual than CGLS64 but produces a worse nonlinear alpha=1 residual; do not infer linear improvement transfers to nonlinear descent.
No dynamic contact, full assembly, accepted time step, or physical qualification is tested.
interpretation.residual: For each signed alpha, native production candidate/projection/force/residual output is compared with b-alpha*A*p. Ratios are against center native residual and exact CSR right-hand side respectively.
